title: Three fixtures still have no pick, and no reachable source publishes a compliant price for them (21 October 2026)
detail: I re-researched the three blanks in the published snapshot (ex-CYBERSHOKE-BlinkDagger 1082762, UPGRADE-flacons 1082763, Zetta-LOS NINOS 1082837) against HLTV, an esportsbook board (Bovada), EGamersWorld's published prices and Valve's official global and regional tables. In each case one side is unranked everywhere and no two-sided match-winner price is published: BlinkDagger is 'Unranked' on both HLTV and VRS and has no recorded maps in 30 days; flacons and LOS NINOS appear in none of Valve's four 2026-10-05 tables; EGamersWorld prints identical 1.80/1.80 placeholder prices for both CIS LAN fixtures; Bovada's live CS2 board carried a CIS LAN Championship section but not these fixtures. The rows therefore stay blank and are listed with their blockers. No probability was invented to fill them.

title: Executive summary labels an HLTV-ranking research pick as 'Valve'
detail: On the live executive summary the Apogee Betclic vs aimclub row is resolved by the HLTV world-ranking research model and links https://www.hltv.org/ranking/teams, but the visible source label reads 'Valve'. The cause is a hardcoded label in the summary's glance renderer ('Valve' for every method='model' quote) that ignores the quote's own source URL. The number and the link are correct; only the attribution text is wrong. Fix requested from the session that owns that renderer; if the file is unowned at integration time this session will correct the label and add a regression assertion.

title: EGamersWorld prints identical 1.80/1.80 on both CIS LAN fixtures; one side's roster is unpublished
detail: Both MPKBK CIS LAN Season 9 fixtures display exactly 1.80 on each side on EGamersWorld, with no bookmaker-average sentence. For UPGRADE vs flacons the flacons lineup block shows five 'noName' placeholders. This is the same placeholder pattern the reviewed aggregated-reference rung already rejects, so neither page can close a blank; it is recorded so the rejection is auditable rather than silent.
